Class ClockDispatch

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.core.ClockDispatch
@Internal public final class ClockDispatch extends Object
Clock skew of the JVM clock reads: System call sites, java.time, the system Clock and java.util.Date.

One domain of the dispatch the instrumentation layer calls through the bootstrap bridge; the evaluation it shares with the other domains is DispatchEngine. Not part of the stable API (see ChaosDispatcher).

    • adjustLocalDateTimeNowInZone

      public LocalDateTime adjustLocalDateTimeNowInZone(LocalDateTime realValue, ZoneId zone)
      Returns the (possibly skewed) LocalDateTime for LocalDateTime.now(ZoneId).

      The skew is applied to the real instant, keeping the value's sub-millisecond part. A local time in a daylight-saving overlap occurs twice; the value was produced just now, so it is the occurrence at the zone's offset in force now, not the earlier one atZone would pick. Without a clock-skew scenario the value is returned before any conversion.

      Parameters:
      realValue - the real local date-time
      zone - the zone the local date-time was produced in
      Returns:
      the (possibly skewed) local date-time
